subject: English
question_text: Who was Shahidullah Kaiser? What happened to him?
guide_solution: Shahidullah Kaiser was Zahir Raihan's brother. He was a famous writer. He was captured and killed by the Pakistani army and the local collaborators during the last days of the liberation war.

question_text: What was the effect of "Stop Genocide"?
